idea: You need the tallest height and how many times it appears. Both can be found in one pass: a taller candle resets the count, an equal one adds to it.
analogy: Measuring a basketball team: when someone taller walks in, they're the new record and the count restarts at one; anyone matching the record adds to the count.

computeWithSinglePass.summary: Track the tallest so far and how many share it.
steps: If a candle is taller than tallest, it becomes the new tallest and count = 1.

computeWithSort.summary: Sort a copy and count equal values at the end.
steps: Count backwards from the last element while values equal the maximum.

pitfalls: Two passes (find max, then count) is fine but not necessary; resetting the count on a new max is the neat part.
interview: HackerRank warm-up: show the single-pass running maximum.
